name: Checkbox
purpose: A single boolean the user sets, or one member of a set they choose from.
notFor: An immediate setting that takes effect on toggle — that is Switch
Choosing exactly one of several options — that is RadioGroup
A filter chip in a toolbar — that is SegmentedControl

anatomy.note: Wraps control, description and error so the three share one id namespace.
The real control. Visually replaced, never visually hidden with display:none, so it stays focusable and keeps native semantics.
aria-hidden. The drawn box; the input above is what a screen reader reads.
Associated by htmlFor/for. Required — a checkbox with no label is unusable by voice control (WCAG 2.5.3).
Referenced by aria-describedby, listed before the description so the failure is announced first.

label.note: Required, not optional-with-aria-label. The visible label is the voice-control target.

error.note: Presence sets aria-invalid and prepends the error id to aria-describedby.

indeterminate.note: A DOM property, not an attribute. React sets it in an effect; Angular must set it in an effect() on the host element. Rendering it as an attribute is the mistake that makes tri-state trees announce the wrong thing.

required.note: Renders a decorative asterisk (aria-hidden) and sets the native required attribute.

keyboard.Tab: Moves focus to the input. Never to the drawn box.

attributes.aria-checked: native, from the input. mixed while indeterminate
attributes.aria-describedby: error id then description id, in that order

aria.labelling: From the associated label element. Required.
aria.focus: Ring on the drawn box, driven from :focus-visible on the input via a sibling selector — so the ring follows the real focus and cannot desynchronise.
aria.announcements: An error appearing is announced by the field, not by a live region: the message is in aria-describedby and read on focus.

content.label: Sentence case, no trailing period. Phrase it so that checked means yes.
content.error: Say what to do: 'Accept the terms to continue', not 'This field is required'.
